description: Specialized gates for Claude Code /usage, MCP token hotspots, context bloat, and agent runtime budget governance.

gates.message: Claude Code usage breakdown requested. Capture runtime_component labels for Skills, Agents, MCPs, Plugins, and subagents so token hotspots can become prevention rules.
MCP context-bloat risk detected. Add a token budget, flush policy, output cap, and disable/allowlist rule before this server dominates agent context.
High-token runtime component detected. Require owner approval with usage evidence, cheaper path considered, budget_decision, and rollback/disable plan before continuing.
Repeated token-waste loop detected. Convert the thumbs-down outcome into a durable lesson or prevention rule before spending more context on the same path.
